title: Build the sinusoidal position clocks
brief: Write the sinusoidal encoding, the matrix that moves it k positions, and the step that adds it to token vectors.
hints: Hand i turns at speed omega_i = 10000 ** (-2 * i / d). The angle at position p is p * omega_i, so np.arange(T)[:, None] * omega[None, :] gives every angle at once.
Write the sines into columns 0::2 and the cosines into columns 1::2 of an empty (T, d) array.
In offset_rotation, the block for hand i sits at rows and columns 2*i and 2*i + 1 and equals [[cos, sin], [-sin, cos]] for the angle k * omega_i.
add_positions returns a new array: x + pe[:T]. Do not use += on x.
